text: 在国家发展改革委今天上午举行的专题新闻发布会上，国家发展改革委有关负责人介绍，正会同有关部门，指导地方开展新一轮深化先进制造业和现代服务业融合发展试点。国家发展改革委产业发展司副司长李春芳表示，围绕工业设计、共性技术服务、中试验证等重点环节，坚持问题导向，分类精准施策，全链条提升服务能力。目前，北京大兴区等28个试点区域，正按照国家部署抓紧深化试点实施方案，力争用两年的时间，因地制宜探索形成一批行之有效的经验做法。同时，依托先进制造业集群，引导民间资本参与生产性服务平台建设，建成一批具有中国特色、国际水准的工业设计中心。推动科技、产业、金融良性循环，打通
text_en: At a special press conference held by the National Development and Reform Commission this morning, a relevant official of the NDRC said it is working with relevant departments to guide local areas in launching a new round of pilot programs to deepen the integrated development of advanced manufacturing and modern services. Li Chunfang, deputy director of the NDRC's Industrial Development Department, said that around key links such as industrial design, common technology services and pilot testing verification, it will adhere to a problem-oriented approach, implement precise policies by category, and improve service capacity across the entire chain. At present, 28 pilot regions including Beijing Daxing District are stepping up work on deepening pilot implementation plans in accordance with national deployment, striving to use two years to explore and form a batch of effective experiences and practices tailored to local conditions. At the same time, relying on advanced manufacturing clusters, it will guide private capital to participate in the construction of productive service platforms, and build a batch of industrial design centers with Chinese characteristics and international standards.
